newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Kantonalbank upgrades CS.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Kantonalbank upgrades CS.

text.p: Zuercher Kantonalbank (ZKB) said it was upgrading the shares of the financial services group CS Group to a buy from hold, but downgraded UBS to hold from buy.

The favourable interest rates environment has led to enormous stock exchange turnover and the three business segments which contribute most to profit improvement -- commissions, service and trading -- account for some 76 percent of gross profits at CS, ZKB said in its Daily Market Opinion.
It said the percentage was considerably higher than was the case at the other two big banks in Switzerland. For example, the three segments accounted for some 62 percent of gross profits at UBS.
"Under the forementioned optimal conditions fantastic half-year are to be expected," the ZKB report said.
On the other hand, it said the UBS share price has risen by 51 percent since the end of January, outperforming the Swiss Performance Index by eight percent and CS Group by four percent.
It also said that in the difficult U.S. market, UBS has had only limited success in getting a foothold.
CS Group's registered shares were 3.50 francs higher at 207.00 at 0930 GMT.
